_doc: Adventure-map town sprites remade cute and chunky (bead bzc.97): dense, tall clusters of buildings round a central landmark in the style of the liked map objects (the roadside inn is the style image), replacing the thin wall rings of faction-towns and towns-3x2. 3x2 towns are requested at 232x176 and seated in the 240x184 canvas; the level towns (Lost World and goblin cities 1-3, the neutral village) at their own canvas sizes. Gate at the bottom centre over the entry cell; no flags. Class contract: docs/art/classes/towns.md. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: the Realm's storybook castle town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a tall fat round castle keep of cream limestone #e6d8b4 with #b3a07a shadows under a big tabard blue #2f6fd0 conical roof with #1f4a8f shadows, two plump round towers with blue cones at either side, crowded in front and at the sides by half-timbered houses with white plaster, dark timbers and warm red-brown roofs #a8492f and a little chapel; across the front a short thick crenellated cream stone wall with a big twin-towered gatehouse and a dark arched gate in the exact middle.

Subject: the Restless' spooky-cute haunted town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a tall crooked gothic cathedral of dark slate #5b5866 with #3a3842 shadows, a pointed bell tower and steep shroud violet #7a4fb5 roofs with #4e2f7a shadows and glowing violet windows, crowded round it a crooked manor house, a round domed mausoleum of bone white stone #d8d0bc, little crypts and leaning cream tombstones; across the front a short thick slate wall topped with black iron railings and a big black iron gate between two fat stone pillars with violet lanterns in the exact middle.
recipes.negative: skeleton, ghost, blood, gore, skull

recipes.subject: Subject: the goblin Horde's ramshackle scrap fortress town filling the whole image width: at the back centre a tall fat boss hall of riveted light grey tin #b8bcc0 with #7d8288 shadows under a bright hazard yellow #f2c230 roof, a crooked wooden lookout tower beside it, crowded round it tin shacks with yellow roofs, a big tawny spotted hide tent and heaps of scrap; across the front a short thick wall of crooked sharpened log stakes #b8733a with #7a4a22 shadows and a big gate crowned by a cream horned ox skull in the exact middle.
recipes.negative: goblin, red
